reflected_formula: rise per Expansion = √(2 × Movement × [gravitational field g] ÷ (Desire × the gap × [area A]))
reflected_sentence: The fall settles where drag and density once set the terms; on this side only the gap and Desire mark them, and the settling comes easier as receptivity rises.
rule_reason: One listed cost: the settled fall-speed rises with mass m, a resistance quantity; one odd cost turns the reading around.
unmapped_terms: drag coefficient C_d (reflected only as the gap)
interpretation: rise per Expansion comes from Movement over Desire, the gap and an unmapped extent, all under the root. The cost turns: stopping the fall gets easier as receptivity replaces opposition. The formula keeps its shape; only the drag coefficient's appearance as the gap is a rule-driven substitution.
closing: The turn was decided by the rule: exactly one cost, rising with mass.
